text:
[Council File 25-1083-S3]
Statutorily Exemption from the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) pursuant to Public Resources Code Section 21080.085(b), and were assessed in the Housing Element Environmental Impact Report No. ENV-2020-6762-EIR (State Clearinghouse No. 2021010130), Addendum No. 1 (ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD1), and Addendum No. 2 (ENV-2020-6762-EIR-ADD2) and related CEQA Findings; City Attorney report and draft Ordinance relative to the Low-Rise Ordinance amending Sections 12.22 A.38 of Article 2, Chapter I of the Los Angeles Municipal Code to locally implement Senate Bill 79, “The Abundant and Affordable Home Near Transit Act” and update the Mixed Income Incentive Program; and adoption of project findings.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
None submitted
